description: The Andhra Pradesh government has allocated 480 acres of land in Visakhapatnam to Adani Infra India for a major AI Data Center project in collaboration with Google, with a projected investment of over ₹87,500 crore.
body_lead: Andhra government allots 480 acres for Adani-Google AI data centre in Visakhapatnam Raiden has specifically requested that all three land parcels identified by Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Ltd (APIIC) may be allotted to Adani Infra (India), as the primary notified partner, subject to completing survey and handing over possession.
